analysis: The supplied units contain CI/test wiring and documentation only, with no provider or coordinator source. No concrete security regression found. integration.yml: the exact-cache lane (head lines 290-291) sets DARKBLOOM_CBV2_KV_QUANTIZATION=native and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_CHECKPOINT_QUANTIZATION=native. The smoke lane (head 320-352) now expects auto and fails if either precision variable is set, so the lanes do not leak env into each other. The workflow's trigger, permissions, secret use and pinned action SHAs are unchanged. HF_READ_TOKEN stays push-only, and pull_request downloads use token=False. The smoke gate changed from asserting contiguous to auto, which weakens a test but is not a security control. Makefile: provider-test adds scripts/test-stage-swiftpm-resource-bundles.py (line 71). benchmark-wrapper-test adds scripts/benchmarks/test_radix_forward_shapes.py and two tests under reports/runtime-kv-path-2026-10-09/qualification (lines 83-85). These run repo-controlled Python in CI only. The scripts themselves are not supplied, so they could not be inspected. changelog.d describes security-relevant provider behaviour not visible in source here: balanced lossy quantization of the encrypted SSD checkpoint (DBK3) rows, new layout/profile identities, bounded CPU re-encode of older rows, and paged capability enforcement independent of legacy prefix reuse. This touches T-041 (the KVCacheSSD at-rest tier) and TB-007. Later passes should check that the layout/profile identities are bound into the GCM AAD, that nothing prompt-derived beyond the HMAC lookupTag is added to metadata, that salt scoping and the HMAC lookup tag derivation are unchanged, that TTL/disk budget are unchanged, and that the CPU conversion and legacy-row restore path fail closed on authentication failure. Also check that the T-041 prose and mitigations are updated if the checkpoint format changed. docs/README.md only adds a link to a new kv-cache-quantization.md doc and bumps a date. Coverage limit: the Swift provider and docs implementing these changes were not supplied.
